review.note: M53: written on Wikidata’s Q2184 — P571 1917-10-25, P576 1991-12-25 — to carry the three events M52 left naming `soviet-union` before its cited inception of 1922-12-30. It stands beside the Soviet Union rather than before it: the two intervals overlap by design, because this was a republic within that union, and no succession is written between them. It holds no territory; the nine CShapes periods of the 1917–1922 gap stay where M52 put them, flagged m52-gap.

summary: A polity whose inception Wikidata states as 1917-10-25 on Q2184 and whose dissolution it states as 1991-12-25. Both years here are those two values and nothing else. It is written because M52 dated `soviet-union` from 1922-12-30, which left three events of 1917 and 1918 — the October Revolution, the Russian Civil War and the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk — naming a state that did not yet exist. This record is what they name instead. It holds no territory: CShapes draws entity 365 across these years under a single label and M52 gave those periods to `soviet-union` with the gap flagged, and moving ground is a claim about borders that this milestone does not make.
